en: The image shows two young girls sitting outdoors in traditional Dutch costume, including detailed embroidered bibs and headscarves. In the background, there are some classic Dutch-style houses and a grassy field beside a waterway. The colors suggest the image may be colorized or painted over a photograph. The caption at the bottom reads: 'De twee zusjes (Marken)', which translates to 'The two sisters (Marken)'.
